_**Agent (gpt-5.5 2026-05-30 16:58:09Z)**_

Use `cp -R` from this project folder.

```bash
cd /Users/omgautam/Documents/portfolio-site
cp -R /path/to/other/folder/. .
```

The `/.` at the end means “copy the contents of that folder,” not the folder itself.

Example:

```bash
cp -R ~/Downloads/my-other-code/. .
```

If you want to avoid overwriting existing files, use interactive mode:

```bash
cp -Ri /path/to/other/folder/. .
```

It will ask before replacing files.

Since this is a git project, I’d recommend checking what changed afterward:

```bash
git status
```
